title: Complete the firstmate study and rebuild the explainer page
summary: Re-study firstmate at the pinned commit 6407052f to add the missed behaviors: teardown reopening a backlog item, yolo self-merge, which events free a place, and the local-only, scout, relaunch and secondmate paths. Update the study records in studies/firstmate-work-handling, then regenerate the page with `cargo run -p xtask -- site`. The audience is a newcomer reading the page and the independent reader checking it against the source.

defaults_applied.how: Every new claim cites a pinned-source path and quote.
Cargo test and the site build are run.
Criteria check the stated behaviors in the records and on the rendered page.
Only the study records and the page they feed change.
The study is re-derived from the source, not just patched for the five listed gaps.

assumptions: The pinned commit stays 6407052f4c521e39401ce2305dfa45d201249827; the pin is not changed.
The page is generated into target/site by xtask from the study files and is not committed, so rebuilding means the study changes render correctly.
The reader's findings are leads to be checked against the source, not facts; each is added only if the source supports it, and corrected if it does not.
xtask/src/site.rs changes only if the new records need rendering the page lacks.

acceptance_criteria.text: The study records state that teardown can reopen a backlog item rather than close it, with a citation to the pinned source path and quote.
The study records state that with yolo on, firstmate merges green work itself, and that otherwise it does not, each with a source citation.
The study records state that only a recorded PR or a cleanup frees a place, with citations.
The study records separate handling of local-only ships, scouts, relaunches and secondmates, each a cited claim.
Each new claim is linked from findings and the model, and validation.json is updated to match the records.
Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy`: the kept study test in crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs passes, so every cited path and quote is checked against the pinned source, and clippy is clean.
Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`: it succeeds, and the generated page shows the new behaviors in terms a newcomer can follow. Each claim on the page traces to a cited study record.

out_of_scope: Changing Athena's study rules or athena.toml
Studying firstmate behavior beyond work handling
departures: A study re-derivation over a pinned source with many cited quotes costs more and passes less often than the typical change, so cost and time are higher and pass probability lower than the reference.
